manifest.name: dsh-prompt-injector
manifest.description: Inject a reusable prompt preset into the FRONT of your DeepSeek Harness message at send time — next message only or every turn, your choice. / DeepSeek Harness 提示词注入器：发送时把预设注入消息首部，可选只注入下一条或每轮都注入。

scripts.check: node scripts/build-client.mjs && node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/config.js && node --check client/client.js && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "test/*.test.js"

manifest.author: yukk4159-bit

bundle.text:
# dsh-prompt-injector bundle patch: one insert row activating the plugin.
#
# Installed through `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <spec>`; the package name is
# listed in the profile's package.json -> dsh.profile.bundles, so this patch is
# loaded automatically. The profile's own cordis.patch.yml can override any field
# below with an entry that has the same `id` (the whole `config` block is replaced,
# not deep-merged).
- insert:
    - id: prompt-injector
      name: 'dsh-prompt-injector'
      config:
        # Master switch. `false` leaves the composer UI in place but injects nothing.
        enabled: true

        # Where the preset text lands relative to what you typed.
        #   prefix — before your text, i.e. the front of the message
        #   suffix — after your text
        position: prefix

        # Wrapper around the injected preset text. `{{name}}` is the preset name,
        # `{{text}}` the preset body. Keep both placeholders.
        template: "[{{name}}]\n{{text}}\n[/{{name}}]"

        # Separator between the preset block and your own text.
        separator: "\n\n"

        # Injected when a message carries no preset token and no preset is selected
        # for the session. Empty means "inject nothing".
        defaultPresetId: ''

        # Only inject for these agent preset ids ('' = every preset).
        agentPresets: []

        # Preset library. Each entry:
        #   id      stable slug; typing {{id}} in a message injects for that one message
        #   name    display name
        #   text    the prompt body that gets injected
        #   tags    free-form labels used by the picker filter
        #   enabled false keeps the entry in the library but unpickable
        presets: []

readme.text: [English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com/harness/) Web 插件：把可复用的提示词预设**在发送的那一刻注入到消息首部**，而不是填进输入框。

注入几次由你决定：**💌 只注入下一条**（默认）或 **💖 每轮都注入**。

萌系二次元画面风格：🌸 粉紫渐变、圆角卡片、会呼吸的小表情。

在 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测可用（Host 侧 67 个用例，浏览器半在真实 GUI 里跑通，见[已验证](#已验证--待验证)）。

先选注入方式，再点预设：

选好之后 chip 变成 `💌 名字 下一条`，**输入框里一个字符都不会多**：

发送时才是注入发生的时刻。下面是「每轮都注入」连发两条的结果——两条消息都带上了预设块，而输入框始终只有你自己写的话：

---

readme.section: 和「提示词预设」类插件的区别
readme.text:
| | 常见的预设插件 | 提示词注入器 |
|---|---|---|
| 选中预设后 | 把提示词**填进输入框** | 只在输入框左侧显示一个 💌 / 💖 徽章，输入框内容完全不动 |
| 你打字时 | 要在一大段提示词后面接着写 | 输入框里只有你自己写的话 |
| 注入几条 | 选中就一直生效 | 默认只注入下一条，发完自动松开；想每轮都注入得自己切 |
| 发送时 | 提示词就是消息的一部分（你在输入框里看得见） | Host 端在 `agent/pre-step` 把提示词**拼到消息最前面** |
| 对话记录 | 提示词和你的话混在一起 | 记录里是完整的注入后文本（模型看到什么，记录就是什么） |

实现位置：`lib/inject.js` 的 `applyInjection()`，注册在 `agent/pre-step` 瀑布事件上——这是消息进入会话日志之前的最后一个接缝。

readme.section: 为什么不是「往输入框塞标记」
readme.text:
最初的设计是往 composer 草稿里写一个不可见的选取标记，随消息一起送到 Host。实测下来这条路在当前版本走不通：

- DSH 的 composer 是 Lexical 编辑器，**没有任何公开的草稿写入服务**；
- Lexical 自己拥有文档状态，直接改 DOM 会被它下一次 reconcile 覆盖；
- 通过 DOM 事件（`execCommand('insertText')`）写入也依赖当前选区，而打开面板后焦点已经不在编辑器上。

所以选择改由 **Host 侧按会话记录**：浏览器半把「这个会话选了哪个预设、注入到什么时候」通过插件的 HTTP 接口告诉 Host（`lib/http.js` 的 `/selection`），Host 在发送瞬间查表注入。这样完全不依赖编辑器的内部实现，也不需要污染消息文本——顺带还让「只注入一条」变得容易实现：Host 注入完就把这条选择丢掉。

readme.section: 为什么不是「往输入框塞标记」
readme.text:
> 早期版本还写了一套「尽力而为」的草稿写入代码，已经删掉了：它写得进去也不起决定作用（真正生效的是 Host 侧的选择），留着只会让「到底谁说了算」变模糊。现在插件**完全不碰输入框**。

---

插件是「bundle」形态（根目录有 `cordis.patch.yml`），用 `dsh plugin` 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:yukk4159-bit/dsh-prompt-injector"
```

`dsh plugin` 把包管理转发给 pnpm，所以也可以装本地路径或指定分支：

```sh

readme.section: 本地检出（改代码时用这个，改完重启就生效）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add "/path/to/prompt-injector"

dsh plugin --profile web add "github:yukk4159-bit/dsh-prompt-injector#main"
```

或者在没有全局 `dsh` 的环境里：

```sh
npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add "github:yukk4159-bit/dsh-prompt-injector"
```

装完**重启该 profile**，然后打开 Web GUI：

- 输入框左边会多一个 🌸 **预设** 按钮 —— 点开挑预设；
- 左侧边栏 → **设置** → **提示词注入器** —— 管理预设库（增删改查、搜索、标签过滤）。

---

1. **设置页**写预设：名字、ID（可选）、标签、注入内容 → 保存。
   保存会写进该 profile 的配置文件（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config.presets`），重启、切会话都不会丢。
2. 在输入框左边点 🌸，面板顶部先选**注入方式**，再点一个预设：
   - **💌 只注入下一条**（默认）——只有你紧接着发送的那一条会被注入，Host 注入完就把这条选择丢掉，再发就干干净净；
   - **💖 每轮都注入**——一直生效，直到你点「取消」。
   面板顶部的切换是**立刻生效**的：已经选了预设时改方式，等于同时把那条选择改成新方式。
   chip 上会写清楚现在是哪种（`💌 名字 下一条` / `💖 名字 每轮`），不会出现「以为只注入一次、其实一直在注入」。
3. 正常写你的话，回车发送。
4. 发送瞬间，Host 把预设正文按模板拼到消息**最前面**再交给模型。
5. 默认方式下，发完那一条之后 chip 自己回到 🌸（面板打开时每 3 秒问一次 Host，因为一次性选择是 Host 释放的，它没法主动通知页面）。
再点一次同一个预设、或点面板里的「取消」即取消。

在消息里直接写 `{{code}}`（`code` 是这个预设的 ID），那一条就会用对应预设，发完即止——这本来就是一次性的，和 chip 的选择互不干扰。

- 写了一个**库里有**的 ID：注入并把这处 `{{code}}` 从消息里拿走；
- 写了一个**库里没有**的 ID：当成普通文字原样发出去，也不会挡住 chip 的选择；
- 指向**已停用**的预设：不注入，文字原样保留。

1. 消息正文里的选取标记（`{{id}}`，或早期版本写入的私有区标记）；
2. **本会话的选择**（就是上面第 2 步记录的那个）；
3. `config.defaultPresetId`。

私有区标记若指向一个不存在或已停用的预设，会**刻意压掉**后两级回退——你点名要它，就不该偷偷换成别的。手打的 `{{id}}` 没这个特权，因为它可能只是普通的文字。

- 选择是**按会话**的：不同会话可以选不同预设，互不干扰。
- 「注入几条」记在浏览器里（`localStorage`），下次打开面板还是你上次选的方式。
- 选择本身存在 Host 进程内存里，重启即清空——它表达的是「这一轮我想用哪个」，不是持久配置。想常驻就用 `defaultPresetId`（它按定义就是每轮都注入）。

```yaml
presets:
  - id: code
    name: 代码评审
    text: 请以资深工程师视角严格评审这段代码，指出风险与改进点。

`config.template` 决定包装形式，支持 `{{name}}`、`{{id}}`、`{{text}}`：

```text
[{{name}}]
{{text}}
[/{{name}}]
```

配 `config.separator`（默认两个换行）拼在你自己的文字和预设块之间。
`config.position` 从 `prefix`（默认，消息首部）改成 `suffix` 就改成拼到末尾。

---

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。关掉后 UI 还在，但不再注入。 |
| `position` | `prefix` | `prefix` 拼到消息首部，`suffix` 拼到末尾。 |
| `template` | `[{{name}}]\n{{text}}\n[/{{name}}]` | 预设正文外面的包装。 |
| `separator` | 两个换行 | 预设块与你自己的文字之间的连接串。 |
| `defaultPresetId` | 空 | 兜底预设：没人选、消息里也没有标记时用它。**它按定义是每轮都注入**；留空表示不注入。 |
| `agentPresets` | `[]` | 只对这些 agent preset 生效；留空表示全部。 |
| `libraryPath` | 空 | 可选的 JSON 副本路径（默认 `<DSH_HOME>/prompt-injector/prompt-injector.json`）。 |
| `presets` | `[]` | 预设库本体。 |

> 「注入几条」不是配置项：它是**每次挑选时的一个手势**，所以留在界面和浏览器里，不写进配置。

---

1. **预设库主存储**：该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `config.presets`。
   设置页保存时通过 Harness 的 `settings.update()` 写回，所以它同时是「插件配置」和「预设库」，设置页的自动表单也能直接编辑它。
2. **可选 JSON 副本**：设置在 `settings` 提供方不可用时（或者你想让库跟着仓库走）会退化写到 `libraryPath`；用一个 profile 里没有的 agent 跑时也能从这里读起来。
3. **会话选择**：只在 Host 进程内存里，不落盘（见上）。

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/library` | 读预设库、标签和全部会话选择 |
| `PUT` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/library` | 整库覆盖写入 |
| `PUT` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/preset` | 新增或更新一条（按 id） |
| `DELETE` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/preset?id=…` | 删除一条 |
| `GET` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/selection` | 只读会话选择（面板的轮询用这条） |
| `PUT` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/selection` | 记录/清空某会话的选择，body 为 `{sessionId, presetId, mode}`，`mode` 取 `once` / `sticky` |

`GET /library` 返回的 `selections` 形如 `{"session-…": {"presetId": "code", "mode": "once"}}`。当 `mode` 是 `once` 时，Host 注入完那一条就会把这一项删掉——所以下一次 `GET` 里它就没了，面板据此把 chip 还原成 🌸。

路径里的 `prompt-injector` 是插件条目 id，两个实例不会互相覆盖。

---

```text
prompt-injector/
├─ cordis.patch.yml        # bundle 入口：一行 insert
├─ package.json            # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 声明
├─ lib/                    # Host 半（Node）

`client/client.js` 是**提交进仓库的构建产物**：Harness 直接加载它，所以别人 clone 下来不需要构建就能装。

```sh
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

脚本自己做四件事：解析相对的 `import`、把 `react` / `react-dom` 转成平台 `require`、把每个源文件包进各自的闭包、最后包成模块加载器要的
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`。没有打包器依赖。

```sh
node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "test/*.test.js"

node scripts/build-client.mjs && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "test/*.test.js"
```

必须写文件通配符：`--experimental-test-isolation=none` 下不能直接传目录。
在受限沙箱（workspace-write）里也必须保留 `--experimental-test-isolation=none`——默认的测试运行器会用管道 spawn 子进程，被沙箱拒绝（EPERM）。

覆盖：预设规范化 / 标记编解码（含手打 `{{id}}`）/ 注入方式归一化 / 模板与拼接 / 消息重写（含非人类消息的排除、禁用预设、
allow-list、`{{id}}` 命中与否）/ 会话选择与一次性释放 / 存储写透与 JSON 原子副本 /
浏览器 bundle 的注册与槽位贡献 / Host 端 `apply()` 的完整 pre-step 路径。
共 67 个用例；其中「Config 默认值」需要 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 可解析，在纯仓库检出里会跳过。

- **注入真的发生在发送时、并且真的到了模型请求里**。用一个临时观察插件监听 `llm/stream`，对 `agent/pre-step` 改写后的消息取证：请求里拿到的是 `[PROBE-INJECTED] Reply with exactly: PROBE-OK`，说明改写后的内容就是模型收到的那一条。
- **插件能被真实 profile 加载**：`dsh plugin --profile <name> add <本目录>` 之后 bundle 层出现 `- id: prompt-injector`，Host 半正常 apply，禁用预设被过滤，HTTP 路由注册成功。
- **浏览器半在真实 GUI 里跑通**：输入框左侧出现 🌸 预设 chip；面板能打开、搜索、按标签过滤；选中后 chip 显示预设名与方式；Host 侧 `/library` 的 `selections` 里能看到该会话的选择；「取消」后选择被清空。
- **「只注入下一条」真的只注入一条**：在预览 profile 里真的打字 + 回车发送 4 条消息（该 profile 用的是假密钥，请求会 401，但注入发生在 `agent/pre-step`，即请求之前）。Host trace 与写进会话日志的正文分别是：
  - 第 1 条（💌 选 `code-review`）：`changed=true preset=code-review source=session`
  - 第 2 条：`changed=false source=none` —— 选择已被释放
  - 第 3 条（切到 💖 `novel`）：`changed=true preset=novel source=session`
  - 第 4 条：`changed=true preset=novel source=session` —— 每轮模式下继续注入
  会话日志里逐条对应：第 1 条带 `[严格代码评审]…` 块，第 2 条**原样**，第 3、4 条都带 `[小说续写]…` 块。发完之后 `GET /selection` 返回 `{}`，chip 自己回到 🌸。
- **手打 `{{id}}` 也对**：发一条 `{{code-review}} 顺手看看 {{nope}} 这个写法`，日志里记下的是预设块 + `顺手看看 {{nope}} 这个写法`——命中的被注入并摘掉，没命中的原样留着。
- **设置页能读能写**：左侧「设置 → 提示词注入器」列出 6 条预设（含停用项，标 🚫），搜索与标签过滤正常，保存后 Host 的 `/library` 确实返回了改动后的库。
- **选择 → 注入的完整链路**（自动化用例）：`test/host.test.js` 里一条测试直接走 HTTP 路由
**没验证的**：真机上模型真的回话（预览 profile 没有可用密钥）、以及 DeepSeek 官方路由以外 provider 的行为——这两件都和注入逻辑无关。

`DSH_PROMPT_INJECTOR_TRACE=1` 会在 stderr 打出 Host 半每一步（apply、库大小、webServer 等待、pre-step 决策、注入结果）。

---

- **注入点是 `agent/pre-step`**。它以 waterfall 方式运行，本插件先调用 `next()`，再改写返回的 `messages`，因此能和压缩等其它 pre-step 策略组合，而不是覆盖它们。
- **只改写「人类写的」用户消息**：`source.kind === 'user'`。运行上下文快照、技能提醒、工具追加都不会被注入。
- **每个 step 最多改写一条**，避免同一个预设被乘上多份。
- **标记用私有区字符**，正常文本里不可能出现，因此不会误伤。
- **失败即放行**：任何注入异常都会被记录并原样放行消息，绝不因为插件问题丢失你发出去的内容。
- **资源都有归属**：路由、效果、样式表都注册在插件 fiber 的 effect 上，插件卸载自动回收。

- **选择只在 Host 进程内存里**，重启 DSH 会清空。它是「这一轮用哪个」的意图，不是持久配置；想常驻请配 `defaultPresetId`。
- 预设库的写入依赖 Harness 的 `settings` 服务。该服务不可用时退化为 JSON 副本，此时设置页的修改只在当前进程内生效。
- 注入后的文本会进入会话日志——这是有意为之：记录应当等于模型真正收到的东西。
- **一次性选择由 Host 释放，页面只能事后知道**：面板打开时每 3 秒 `GET /selection` 一次（只在有一次性选择待发时轮询）。所以发完消息后 chip 可能需要最多 3 秒才从 💌 变回 🌸——这不影响注入，只是徽章慢一拍。
- `{{id}}` 只在 ID 命中库里的预设时才当作引用，所以预设 ID 起得越像普通词（例如 `code`），越有可能误伤正文里的 `{{code}}` 写法。介意的话把 ID 起得独特一点（例如 `pi-code`）。

欢迎开 issue 报 bug、提想法，或者直接 PR。改浏览器半的代码之后记得跑一次

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com/harness/) web plugin: reusable prompt presets are **injected into the front of the message at the moment it is sent**, instead of being typed into the composer.

How many times it injects is your call: **💌 inject the next message only** (default) or **💖 inject on every turn**.

Cute anime-style visuals: 🌸 pink-purple gradients, rounded cards, a little face that breathes.
Measured working on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` (67 cases on the host side; the browser half has been exercised in a real GUI — see [Verified](#verified--not-yet-verified)).

First choose the injection mode, then click a preset:

Once picked, the chip becomes `💌 名字 下一条`, and **not one extra character lands in the composer**:

Send time is when the injection actually happens. Below is the result of sending twice in a row in 💖 每轮都注入 mode — both messages carry the preset block, while the composer still holds only what you wrote:

---

readme.section: How it differs from "prompt preset" plugins
readme.text:
| | Common preset plugins | Prompt Injector |
|---|---|---|
| After picking a preset | The prompt is **filled into the composer** | Only a 💌 / 💖 badge appears to the left of the composer; the composer content does not move at all |
| While you type | You have to keep writing after a long block of prompt text | The composer holds only what you wrote |
| How many messages | Active for as long as it is picked | The next message only by default, then released automatically; injecting every turn is a switch you flip yourself |
| At send time | The prompt is part of the message (you can see it in the composer) | The host **prepends the prompt to the message** at `agent/pre-step` |
| Session log | The prompt is mixed in with your words | The log holds the complete injected text (whatever the model sees is what the log records) |

readme.section: How it differs from "prompt preset" plugins
readme.text: Where it is implemented: `applyInjection()` in `lib/inject.js`, registered on the `agent/pre-step` waterfall event — the last seam before messages enter the session log.

readme.section: Why not "stuff a marker into the composer"
readme.text: The original design was to write an invisible pick marker into the composer draft and send it to the host along with the message. In practice that road does not work in the current version:

readme.section: Why not "stuff a marker into the composer"
Why not "stuff a marker into the composer"
readme.text: So the choice was to let the **host keep it per session** instead: the browser half tells the host "which preset this session picked, and until when" through the plugin's HTTP interface (`/selection` in `lib/http.js`), and the host looks it up and injects at the instant of sending. This depends on none of the editor's internals and needs no polluting of the message text — and it incidentally makes "inject one message only" easy to implement: the host drops the selection as soon as it has injected.

readme.section: Why not "stuff a marker into the composer"
readme.text:
> An earlier version also wrote a "best effort" draft writer; that code has been deleted. Writing into the draft made no difference anyway (the host-side selection is what actually decides), and keeping it around only blurred "who is in charge". The plugin now **never touches the composer**.

---

The plugin is a "bundle" (there is a `cordis.patch.yml` in the repository root); install it with `dsh plugin`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:yukk4159-bit/dsh-prompt-injector"
```

`dsh plugin` forwards package management to pnpm, so a local path or a specific branch works too:

```sh

readme.section: local checkout (use this while changing code; it takes effect after a restart)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add "/path/to/prompt-injector"

dsh plugin --profile web add "github:yukk4159-bit/dsh-prompt-injector#main"
```

Or, in an environment without a global `dsh`:

```sh
npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add "github:yukk4159-bit/dsh-prompt-injector"
```

After installing, **restart that profile**, then open the Web GUI:

1. **Settings page**: write a preset — name, ID (optional), tags, injection content → save.
   Saving writes into that profile's config file (`config.presets` in `cordis.patch.yml`), so it survives restarts and session switches.
2. Click 🌸 to the left of the composer. At the top of the panel, first choose the **injection mode**, then click a preset:
   - **💌 inject the next message only** (default) — only the message you send right after this one is injected; the host drops the selection as soon as it has injected, so the next send is clean;
   - **💖 inject on every turn** — stays in effect until you click "cancel".
   The switch at the top of the panel takes effect **immediately**: when a preset is already picked, changing the mode also moves that pick to the new mode.
   The chip spells out which one is active (`💌 名字 下一条` / `💖 名字 每轮`), so "thought it was once, was actually injecting all along" cannot happen.
3. Write your message normally and press Enter to send.
4. At the instant of sending, the host wraps the preset body in the template and prepends it to the **front** of the message before handing it to the model.
5. In the default mode, the chip returns to 🌸 by itself after t
Clicking the same preset again, or "cancel" in the panel, cancels it.

Write `{{code}}` directly in a message (`code` being that preset's ID) and that one message uses the corresponding preset, once and done — this is one-shot by nature, and it does not interfere with the chip's selection.

- A selection is **per session**: different sessions can pick different presets without interfering with each other.
- "How many messages to inject" is remembered in the browser (`localStorage`), so the next time you open the panel it is still the mode you chose last time.
- The selection itself lives in host process memory and is cleared by a restart — it expresses "which one I want for this turn", not persistent configuration. For something permanent use `defaultPresetId` (which by definition injects on every turn).

```yaml
presets:
  - id: code
    name: 代码评审
    text: 请以资深工程师视角严格评审这段代码，指出风险与改进点。

`config.template` decides the wrapping form; it supports `{{name}}`, `{{id}}`, `{{text}}`:

```text
[{{name}}]
{{text}}
[/{{name}}]
```

`config.separator` (two newlines by default) is joined between your own text and the preset block.
Change `config.position` from `prefix` (the default, front of the message) to `suffix` and it is appended at the end instead.

---

| Config | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. When off the UI is still there, but nothing is injected any more. |
| `position` | `prefix` | `prefix` prepends to the front of the message, `suffix` appends to the end. |
| `template` | `[{{name}}]\n{{text}}\n[/{{name}}]` | The wrapper around the preset body. |
| `separator` | two newlines | The joining string between the preset block and your own text. |
| `defaultPresetId` | empty | Fallback preset: used when nobody picked one and the message carries no marker. **It injects on every turn by definition**; empty means no injection. |
| `agentPresets` | `[]` | Only takes effect for these agent presets; empty means all of them. |
| `libraryPath` | empty | Optional JSON copy path (default `<DSH_HOME>/prompt-injector/prompt-injector.json`). |
| `presets` | `[]` | The preset library itself. |

> "How many messages to inject" is not a config option: it is **a gesture made each time you pick**, so it stays in the UI and in the browser instead of being written into the config.

---

1. **Primary storage for the preset library**: `config.presets` in that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
   The settings page writes it back through the Harness `settings.update()` when saving, so it is both "plugin config" and "preset library", and the automatic form on the settings page can edit it directly as well.
2. **Optional JSON copy**: when the `settings` provider is unavailable (or you want the library to travel with the repository), writes degrade to `libraryPath`; it can also be read from there when running with an agent the profile does not have.
3. **Session selection**: only in host process memory, never written to disk (see above).

The browser half talks to the host half over these three routes; they are mounted on the composed host web server, so they are protected by that server's browser-trust fence and authentication as well.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/library` | Read the preset library, the tags and every session selection |
| `PUT` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/library` | Overwrite the whole library |
| `PUT` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/preset` | Add or update one entry (by id) |
| `DELETE` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/preset?id=…` | Delete one entry |
| `GET` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/selection` | Read-only session selections (this is what the panel polls) |
| `PUT` | `/prompt-injector/prompt-injector/selection` | Record/clear one session's selection; the body is `{sessionId, presetId, mode}`, where `mode` is `once` / `sticky` |

The `selections` returned by `GET /library` looks like `{"session-…": {"presetId": "code", "mode": "once"}}`. When `mode` is `once`, the host deletes that entry as soon as it has injected that one message — so it is gone from the next `GET`, which is how the panel restores the chip to 🌸.

The `prompt-injector` in the path is the plugin entry id, so two instances never overwrite each other.

---

```text
prompt-injector/
├─ cordis.patch.yml        # bundle entry: a single insert line
├─ package.json            # dsh.bundle + dsh.client declarations
├─ lib/                    # host half (Node)

`client/client.js` is a **build artifact committed to the repository**: Harness loads it directly, so anyone who clones the repository can install the plugin without building it first.

```sh
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

The script does four things by itself: resolve relative `import`s, turn `react` / `react-dom` into platform `require`s, wrap each source file in its own closure, and finally package it as the module loader expects:
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`. No bundler dependency.

```sh
node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "test/*.test.js"

node scripts/build-client.mjs && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "test/*.test.js"
```

The file glob is required: under `--experimental-test-isolation=none` a directory cannot be passed directly.
Inside a restricted sandbox (`workspace-write`) you must also keep `--experimental-test-isolation=none` — the default test runner spawns child processes over pipes, which the sandbox rejects (EPERM).

Coverage: preset normalization / marker encode-decode (including hand-typed `{{id}}`) / injection-mode normalization / template and composition / message rewriting (including exclusion of non-human messages, disabled presets, allow-list, `{{id}}` hit or miss) / session selections and one-shot release / store write-through and the atomic JSON copy / registration and slot contributions of the browser bundle / the full pre-step path of the host half's `apply()`.
67 cases in total; of those, "Config defaults" needs `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` to resolve and is skipped in a plain repository checkout.

- **The injection really happens at send time, and really reaches the model request.** A temporary observer plugin listened on `llm/stream` and took evidence from the messages rewritten at `agent/pre-step`: the request contained `[PROBE-INJECTED] Reply with exactly: PROBE-OK`, showing that the rewritten content is exactly the message the model receives.
- **The plugin loads in a real profile**: after `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <this directory>` the bundle layer shows `- id: prompt-injector`, the host half applies normally, disabled presets are filtered out, and the HTTP routes register successfully.
- **The browser half runs in a real GUI**: the 🌸 preset chip appears to the left of the composer; the panel opens, searches and filters by tag; after picking, the chip shows the preset name and the mode; that session's selection can be seen in `selections` from the host's `/library`; after "cancel" the selection is cleared.
- **"Inject the next message only" really injects exactly one**: in a preview profile, 4 messages were really typed and sent with Enter (that profile uses a fake key, so the requests get 401, but the injection happens at `agent/pre-step`, i.e. before the reques

**Not verified**: an actual model reply on real hardware (the preview profile has no usable key), and the behaviour of providers other than the official DeepSeek route — neither of these has anything to do with the injection logic.

`DSH_PROMPT_INJECTOR_TRACE=1` prints every step of the host half to stderr (apply, library size, the webServer wait, the pre-step decision, the injection result).

---

- **The injection point is `agent/pre-step`.** It runs as a waterfall, and this plugin calls `next()` first and then rewrites the returned `messages`, so it composes with compaction and other pre-step policies instead of overriding them.
- **Only "human-written" user messages are rewritten**: `source.kind === 'user'`. Runtime-context snapshots, skill reminders and tool additions are never injected into.
- **At most one message is rewritten per step**, so the same preset is never multiplied.
- **Markers use private-use characters**, which cannot occur in normal text, so there are no false positives.
- **Failure lets the message through**: any injection error is logged and the message passes unchanged; content you sent is never lost because of a plugin problem.
- **Every resource has an owner**: routes, effects and stylesheets are all registered on the plugin fiber's effect, and are reclaimed automatically when the plugin unloads.

- **A selection lives only in host process memory**, and restarting DSH clears it. It is the intent "which one for this round", not persistent configuration; for something permanent configure `defaultPresetId`.
- Writes to the preset library depend on the Harness `settings` service. When it is unavailable the store degrades to the JSON copy, and in that case edits from the settings page only take effect within the current process.
- The injected text does enter the session log — deliberately so: the record should equal what the model actually received.
- **A one-shot selection is released by the host, and the page can only find out after the fact**: while the panel is open it calls `GET /selection` once every 3 seconds (polling only while a one-shot selection is waiting to be sent). So after sending a message the chip can take up to 3 seconds to change from 💌 back to 🌸 — this does not affect injection, the badge is just one beat late.
- `{{id}}` only counts as a reference when the ID matches a preset in the library, so the more a preset ID looks like an ordinary word (for example `code`), the more likely it is to catch a `{{code}}` written in ordinary prose. If that bothers you, gi

`node scripts/build-client.mjs` — `client/client.js` is a build artifact that has to be committed along with the change.
